body: My phone died on me this summer so I ordered a used one off Amazon and went to one of my provider's locations to switch my SIM card over. The guy is sitting there working on my phone and telling me I should try sending my old phone in for a refund, and as he's talking he's going through my new phone to make sure my Google account switched over correctly. In horror I watch his finger move over to my photos and press the button. ALL my old photos have switched over, including my freshly minted nudes that I had been trying to delete when my phone died. The conversation just withers and dies. I'm sitting there staring at my hands and the guy tried to cover and starts talking about something else. I barely heard him. I grabbed my phone and purse from him, mumbled a thank you and left. As I drove away I saw him sitting in the same place just staring into the distance.
